issues.title: Modal misalignment and missing scrim
issues.description: The confirm payment sheet is positioned off-center and overlaps background panels without a backdrop scrim.
issues.evidence: The sheet sits over the right-hand API calls panel, partially obscuring the lower endpoints.
issues.suggestion: Center the sheet in the viewport and apply a standard backdrop overlay.
issues.triageNote: Real dark-theme defect: the bg-default-font/[0.34] scrim inverted with the ink token (near-white in dark) into a 34% white haze, so the sheet read as an un-scrimmed floating panel. Replaced with a black scrim — bg-[#00000057] in light (unchanged 34% ink strength) deepened to dark:bg-[#00000099] (60%, matching ds:Dialog) because a vision re-audit confirmed flat 34% black is still imperceptible over the near-black dark page. The 'off-center' half is the documented bottom-anchored, horizontally centered design — not a defect.

issues.title: RTL action alignment in modal footer
issues.description: The dialog actions are aligned to the left edge rather than the expected start edge in RTL layout.
issues.evidence: Footer buttons 'تأكيد الشراء' and 'إلغاء' sit at the bottom-left corner of the sheet.
issues.suggestion: Align modal footer actions to the start edge (right) or use a consistent full-width/RTL ordering.
issues.triageNote: justify-end is direction-aware flexbox (main-axis end = left edge in RTL), so confirm/cancel docking bottom-left in RTL is the correct mirrored position — same convention as ds:Dialog's demo footer and standard Material/Apple RTL mirroring. No physical classes exist in Sheet.tsx or demo.tsx; meta usage + demo comment updated to teach the logical-alignment pattern.
